name: Barkeep Daniels
summary: At the Lakeshire Inn, Barkeep Daniels keeps drinks flowing as raiders disrupt the roads. The town guards, fishermen, and travelers who gather there depend on the inn for a welcome pause, but supplies are running low.

sections.title: Keeping Spirits High in Lakeshire
sections.body: Barkeep Daniels pours drinks and greets visitors at the Lakeshire Inn, near the bridge. Gnolls and Blackrock orcs have kept Lakeshire under pressure for months, and its defenders turn to the tavern after grim patrols. Raids and severed roads have disrupted trade across the region. With liquor running low when the town needs good cheer, Daniels welcomes travelers willing to fetch shipments from safer settlements.

faq.answer: Barkeep Daniels keeps the counter at the Lakeshire Inn, serving drinks to townsfolk, travelers, and the town guard.

faq.q: Why is he running low on drinks?
faq.answer: Blackrock orc and gnoll raids have choked off caravans and trade routes into the Redridge Mountains. With deliveries cut off and stressed defenders drinking through the stores, Daniels struggles to restock the shelves.

faq.q: What does he need help with?
faq.answer: Daniels needs travelers to bring fresh liquor from outside Redridge so the inn can keep serving its patrons.

angles.text: For the Alliance, keeping morale high in Lakeshire matters. The settlement is the kingdom's battered buffer against the Blackrock stronghold in the north.
